slides.title: Welcome
slides.narration: Welcome to this Spoken Tutorial on Misinformation and Deepfakes.

slides.title: Learning Objectives
slides.narration:
In this tutorial, you will learn to understand how **AI** creates deepfakes.
You will also identify the risks of deepfake content.
Finally, you will apply methods to spot misinformation.

slides.title: System Requirements
slides.narration:
You will need a device with internet access.
A web browser is also required.

slides.title: Prerequisites
slides.narration:
Basic understanding of how **AI** works is helpful.
No prior coding knowledge is needed.

slides.title: What are Deepfakes?
slides.narration:
Have you seen videos that seem real but are not?
These are often called deepfakes.
Deepfakes are synthetic media.
They are created using powerful **AI** algorithms.
slides.image_prompt: realistic fake content generated by AI

slides.title: **AI** Behind Deepfakes
slides.narration:
**AI** uses something called **Deep Learning**.
It learns patterns from many real images.
Then it generates new, fake content.
This content looks very convincing.

slides.title: Forms of Deepfake Content
slides.narration:
Deepfakes can be audio, video, or images.
Audio deepfakes mimic a person's voice.
Video deepfakes can swap faces.
They can also make people say new things.

slides.title: Dangers of Deepfakes
slides.narration:
What happens if fake content looks real?
Deepfakes spread misinformation quickly.
They can damage reputations easily.
They can even influence public opinion.
slides.image_prompt: risks and dangers of deepfake technology

slides.title: Deepfakes in the News
slides.narration:
Fake videos of politicians have appeared.
These videos spread false statements.
Audio deepfakes have been used in scams.
They trick people into giving money.

slides.title: Impact on Society
slides.narration:
Deepfakes erode trust in media.
It becomes hard to tell truth from lies.
This can destabilize societies.
It can also cause confusion during events.

slides.title: Verify Your Sources
slides.narration:
How can we combat these fakes?
Always check where information comes from.
Is the source trustworthy and reliable?
Look for official channels and news.

slides.title: Cultivate Media Literacy
slides.narration:
Develop strong media literacy skills.
Question what you see and hear online.
Look for inconsistencies in content.
Educate yourself on deepfake signs.

slides.title: Summary
slides.narration:
This module covered deepfakes and their risks.
We also learned about verifying sources.
Remember to always be critical of online content.

slides.title: Assignment
slides.narration:
Find one news article discussing a deepfake incident.
Reflect on its impact.
Share your findings with a friend.
